title: Britain's Wild Places: Water Voles
description: An intimate portrait of one of Britain's most charming wild animals, following a family of water voles living on a canal in Derbyshire though a typical year.

title: Full Circle with Michael Palin
description: From the Philippines, Michael Palin crosses the Sulu Sea in a leaky ferry. He travels on through the Borneo jungle to Java, where he climbs a volcano.

title: Miss Marple: The Moving Finger
description: When everyone in a small town receives malicious letters detailing a future murder, it is Miss Marple who is called upon to help reveal the clues.

title: Around the World in 80 Treasures
description: Dan is captivated by the sword of a Samurai warrior and the artistry employed to make this beautiful instrument of death.

title: Ran
description: Reworking of Shakespeare's King Lear set in medieval Japan. Contains prolonged violent scenes.

title: Kurosawa - Arena
description: Documentary profile of celebrated Japanese film-maker Akira Kurosawa. Contains scenes which some viewers may find upsetting.

title: To the Manor Born
description: Stately sitcom. A repair bill for Audrey's Rolls-Royce finally convinces her to revert to four-legged horsepower.

title: Keeping Up Appearances
description: Sitcom. When Hyacinth hears that Emmet is rehearsing a musical, she is beside herself. Unfortunately sorting out Daddy's antics has to take priority.

title: Miss Marple: The Moving Finger
description: When everyone in a small town receives malicious letters detailing a future murder, it is Miss Marple who is called upon to help reveal the clues.

title: People's Palaces: The Golden Age of Civic Architecture
description: Jonathan Foyle explores northern Georgian and Victorian neo-classical civic buildings.

title: The Medici: Makers of Modern Art
description: Andrew Graham-Dixon reveals how the Medici family transformed Florence through sculpture, painting and architecture, and became the financial engine behind the Italian Renaissance.

title: Britain's Most Fragile Treasure
description: Dr Janina Ramirez unlocks the secrets of a centuries-old masterpiece in glass, the Great East Window at York Minster, the largest expanse of medieval stained glass in the UK.

title: Gilbert and Sullivan's The Gondoliers
description: Scottish Opera's sparkling staging of Gilbert and Sullivan's witty satire set in Venice.
